summary: Full review approved by Antigravity Lead Supervisor. The Phase 3 Quick-Cast Arcane Dock & Talent Bar has been thoroughly implemented and verified across automated test suites, C++ WebTiles compilation, and live browser gameplay. Memorised spells and character abilities display authentic DCSS sprites, live MP costs, failure percentages, and standardized keybind badges ('[z] [a]', '[a] [a]'). Mouse-click casting dispatches cleanly through native Crawl targeting and confirmation without rule bypasses. The empty dock provides a clean prompt and 'Memorise [M]' button. Dynamic layout geometry preserves strict clearance between the Action Dock, Arcane Dock, Tactical Chronicle, chat strip, and right sidebar HUD.

findings.component: Native Spell & Talent Execution (tileweb.cc, main.cc, macro.cc, spl-cast.cc, ability.cc)
findings.notes: Selection requests are processed through guarded command mode boundaries. Crawl's native targeting, confirmation, MP deduction, and failure rolls apply directly. Keyboard replay state is preserved and mixed inputs cannot leak across prompts.

findings.component: Quick-Cast Arcane Dock & Talent Bar UI (arcane_dock.js, game.html, style.css)
findings.notes: Authentic DCSS icons from icons.png. Real-time MP cost and failure rate readouts with immediate disabled states upon insufficient MP or status afflictions (silence, confusion, paralysis). Non-spellcasters receive an empty dock state with a functional 'Memorise [M]' button.

All 6 arcane_dock_test suites passed. All 7 chronicle_minimap, 6 hero HUD, 22 examination card, 9 floating event, and 24 ai-team tests passed (50 node + 24 python tests). C++ WebTiles binary recompiled cleanly (20,663,928 bytes).

Verified in Chromium on port 8088. Tested Deep Elf Conjurer: verified Magic Dart (1 MP, 1% fail, [z] [a]) and Searing Ray (2 MP, 1% fail, [z] [b]) with authentic sprites. Clicking Magic Dart entered native crosshair targeting on Endoplasm, cleanly cancelled with Escape. Tested Minotaur Fighter: empty dock rendered 'Memorise [M]' which triggered native library check.

recommendations: Commit review record and handoff sign-off, push feature/webtiles-arcane-dock to origin, and open Pull Request #14 for user approval.
